contexts.text: Their greatest delight was to procreate offspring. Explained.
(Adulterers reason that they promote the procreation of offspring.)
Had thus extinguished the desire... for the procreation of infants...
Still had not extinguished the natural desire of procreating offspring.
Divine order... goes to the ultimate... and, by media there collected, redintegrates and produces itself further, which is done by procreations. LJ 20.

b. Marriages on earth are also for the sake of the procreation of offspring; but not in the Heavens. Instead of this procreation, there is, in the Heavens, the procreation of good and truth. Explained.
Conjugial delight... is more excellent than all others on account of its use, which is the procreation of the human race, and thence of the Angels of Heaven.
That the procreations of the human race on earth will never cease. General article.
The procreations of wisdom from love are like seeds, by which procreations man becomes like a garden.
Therefore all things in the universe are procreated and formed from use, in use, and for use.
Impotence is a cause of separation, because the end of marriage is the procreation of offspring.
That two universal spheres proceed from the Lord to preserve the universe... One is the sphere of procreating, and the other is that of protecting the things procreated. Explained.

For the love of procreating is continued into the love of the thing procreated. The reality of the love of procreating is Known from its delight, in that it is supereminent and transcendant. In this delight is the state of procreation with men...

That the sphere of the love of procreating progresses in order from the end through the causes into the effects, and makes periods, through which the universe is preserved in its foreseen and provided state. Explained. CL 401.

The love of procreating, and the derivative sequent love of the things procreated, are implanted in the conjugial love with women; but these two loves are divided with them, when the end, which is the love of procreating, commences its progression... The love of procreating, which, with a woman makes a one with her conjugial love, is then not alike.

Conjugial love is implanted in every woman from creation, and, together with it, the love of procreating, which is determined to and flows unto the procreated offspring, and, from the women, is introduced into the men.
Wisdom increases through the marriages in the Heavens, which, there, is instead of procreation.

Father, mother, sons, daughters = the goods and truths which procreate, and the goods and truths procreated. But it is to be known that the goods and truths which procreate are in the spiritual man, and the goods and truths procreated are in the natural... Hence it is evident, that those spiritual procreations, like the natural procreations from father and mother, are multiplied like families...
6. That the angelic mind cannot be procreated, and be multiplied by procreations, except in man. Explained.

With the Angels no other procreation and thence multiplication is possible than spiritual, which is that of wisdom and love... But in the natural world there are matters, through which and from which, procreations, and afterwards formations, can be effected...

5. 3. A natural origin has been added, that things may be at the same time material and fixed, for the sake of the end of the procreation of the human race, which is not possible except in ultimates, where there is what is full...
